jessica (cs): FYI customer acct42 is hitting 422 on /v1/rerank, says scores are all zero. payload pasted below.
customer_acct42: \"We pushed this and got a 422 + all scores=0. curl + body:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"query\": \"how do I reset my api key\",\"documents\": [{\"id\": \"d1\",\"text\": \"Steps to reset...\",\"query\": \"reset\"},{\"id\":\"d2\",\"text\": \"Rotate keys...\"}],\"candidates\": [\"reset api key\", \"rotate key\"] }'
```
jessica (cs): thanks — that nested "query" inside documents stood out to me.
dicegoops: @diego can you repro?
diego (ml): repro'd locally, short version: our rerank parser flattens keys and the last-seen "query" ends up used. With per-doc "query" present the effective query becomes that (or empty), which leads to degenerate scores. I got a 422 on validation + zeroed scores when we fell back.
customer_acct42: ah interesting — we included small per-snippet queries to tune scorers. worked on our old infra.
isha (platform): current spec expects a single top-level "query" string for the rerank endpoint. We don't support per-document query overrides. Ideally the client should put per-snippet hints under a different key (e.g., "snippetQuery" or metadata).
diego (ml): reproducer I used (minimised):
```json
{
  "query": "how to reset",
  "documents": [ {"id":"d1","text":"reset steps","query":"reset"} ],
  "candidates": ["reset password"]
}
```
When parser walks the JSON it currently treats inner "query" as override. That means the top-level query becomes ambiguous and our reranker gets the wrong input; result is either a validation 422 or blank query leading to even scores.
jessica (cs): Workaround suggestion to customer: rename the inner field to "snippetQuery" or move it to "metadata". If you can send the request id we can patch logs.
isha (platform): I'll add a validation rule to reject nested "query" keys for /v1/rerank and return a terse error message like: "nested \u2018query\u2019 found; use top-level \u2018query\u2019 or rename nested field". Putting this in the next sprint.
diego (ml): opening GH issue #1523 and will draft a parser patch to prefer the top-level key and also to hard-fail on conflicting keys. Assigning to me, ETA: patch + tests by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for branch/issue-1523 (tests pending).
customer_acct42: Renaming inner key to "snippetQuery" fixed it for us. Scores look sensible now. Thanks for the fast turnaround! :tada:
jessica (cs): Great — closing the immediate support loop. Will follow up when validation change is live so they can remove the workaround. :thumbsup:
